# 12. Multi-Panel Figures & Export

```{r}
#| label: export-figures
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Figure 1: Lamb survival vs average snow depth and snow cover duration

common_size_scale_lamb <- scale_size_continuous(
  name = "Sample size (N)",
  limits = c(1, 50),
  breaks = c(5, 10, 20, 30, 50),
  range = c(1.5, 7)
)

lamb_depth_styled <- lamb_depth + common_size_scale_lamb + guides(size = "none")
lamb_days_styled  <- lamb_days  + common_size_scale_lamb 

final_plot_lamb <- lamb_depth_styled + lamb_days_styled +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) &
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just  = "center",
    legend.margin    = margin(t = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 18), 
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 16),      
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 16),      
    plot.tag         = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  "Figure1_bis.pdf", 
  device = cairo_pdf,
  plot   = final_plot_lamb,
  width  = 12,              
  height = 8
)

# Figure 2: Survival vs snow thresholds (Lambs, Females, Males)
common_size_scale <- scale_size_continuous(
  name = "Sample size (N)",
  limits = c(1, 1000),
  breaks = c(50, 200, 500, 1000),
  range = c(1.5, 7)
)

p_sex_days90_styled <- p_sex_days90 + common_size_scale + guides(size = "none")
p_fem_thresh_styled <- p_fem_thresh + common_size_scale 
p_male_thresh_styled <- p_male_thresh + common_size_scale + guides(size = "none")

final_plot_thresh <- p_sex_days90_styled + p_fem_thresh_styled + p_male_thresh_styled +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) &
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just  = "center",
    legend.margin    = margin(t = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 18),      
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 18),      
    plot.tag         = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  "Figure2.pdf", 
  device = cairo_pdf,
  plot   = final_plot_thresh,
  width  = 18,              
  height = 8
)

# Figure 3: Trends in extreme snow days (90 cm & 100 cm)

  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just  = "center",
    legend.margin    = margin(t = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 18),      
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 18),        
    plot.tag         = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  "Figure3.pdf", 
  device = cairo_pdf,
  plot   = final_plot_trend,
  width  = 15,              
  height = 12
)


# Figure 4: Survival trends across demographic classes

common_size_scale_trend <- scale_size_continuous(
  name = "Sample size (N)",
  limits = c(1, 200),
  breaks = c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200),
  range = c(1.5, 7)
)

lamb_trend_styled   <- lamb_trend   + common_size_scale_trend + guides(size = "none")
female_trend_styled <- female_trend + common_size_scale_trend 
male_trend_styled   <- male_trend   + common_size_scale_trend + guides(size = "none")

final_plot_surv_trend <- lamb_trend_styled + female_trend_styled + male_trend_styled +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) &
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just  = "center",
    legend.margin    = margin(t = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 20), 
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 18),      
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 18),        
    plot.tag         = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  "Figure4_bis.pdf", 
  device = cairo_pdf,
  plot   = final_plot_surv_trend,
  width  = 18,              
  height = 8
)
```
